thread:
tessa: Quick clarifying Q from today's all-hands: are we definitely switching to 2-week or 3-week minor releases? there was some back-and-forth in the Q&A.
ben: Sorry for the confusion. Final decision: 3-week minor cadence. We evaluated team overhead vs. customer churn and 3w felt like the sweet spot. Major releases stay monthly.
rachel: Are there any new hard gates that teams should know about before promoting to prod?
sre-lead: Yes 
- unit + integration green
- staging smoke e2e pass
- perf baseline check (see below)
- rollout plan with owner and notif list in the ticket
Also: feature flags for all customer-visible changes, or a documented canary.
oncall-bot: Reminder: tag @sre and @ops 24h before any planned canary; include a short runbook snippet in the ticket.
ev an: Perf thresholds: what numbers are we using as roll-back triggers?
sre-lead: Agreed thresholds for now: error rate absolute delta >1.0% -> rollback. p99 latency >20% vs baseline -> rollback. p95 >12% -> manual review (may continue if mitigations are in place). These are intentionally slightly conservative while we tune.
pm-amy: Do hosted SLAs change with this cadence? several customers asked during renewals.
ben: No SLA changes. We will improve internal visibility: per-route SLO dashboards (30/90 day baselines) and pre-release risk badges on PRs so PMs and AEs can triage renewal questions.
tessa: Canary guidance (percent/time) requested by a couple of teams?
sre-lead: Recommended pattern: 5% for 1-3 hours (smoke), 20% for 6-12 hours (monitor), then 50% hold 6h before full. For high-risk endpoints start 10% longer hold. Always monitor synthetics + p99/p95 + error-rate.
docsteam: Can someone distill this into a one-pager checklist + a short customer blurb? I can fold into handbook and share with sales.
ben: I'll draft the checklist. Tessa offered to co-author the customer blurb. We aim to PR the handbook by next Tuesday.
ev an: Post-release retro cadence? teams asked for a quick loop to capture regressions.
sre-lead: Add a 10-15m async retro template for every release, mandatory 15m live if there was an auto-rollback or a customer impact. We'll add a checkbox to the release ticket to enforce it.
ton: Small ops ask: when a canary crosses an oncall shift, please confirm with incoming oncall 12h beforehand and handover the runbook.
oncall-bot: Auto-note: use `deployctl canary --svc <svc> --pct 5,20,50 --hold 6h --notify @sre` to standardize.
pm-amy: thanks everyone. does anyone object to these thresholds being experimental for one quarter? we can recalibrate after 12 weeks.
sre-lead: No objections. We'll collect telemetry and propose adjustments at the next ops review.
tessa: Awesome. Tag me when the handbook PR is up and I'll loop in docs + sales.
